run_fim_language_modeling: run fill-in-the-middle fine-tuning on a causal language model with HuggingFace Transformers
create_fim_dataset: create a dataset with FIM transformations applied to tokenized text examples
configure_fim_model_training: configure a causal language model with FIM special tokens and multivariate normal embedding initialization
apply_fim_transformation: apply fill-in-the-middle or suffix-prefix-middle transformations to token sequences with configurable rates
evaluate_fim_model: evaluate a fine-tuned FIM language model and compute perplexity and accuracy metrics
